title: NICAS Level 1
subtitle: Indoor Toprope Foundation
description: Master the fundamental skills for safe indoor toprope climbing.

skills.label: Fit and check a harness independently
Tie a figure-of-eight retrace knot correctly
Complete a buddy check before climbing
Thread and lock a belay device correctly
Belay a climber safely on toprope
Lower a climber smoothly to the ground
Use standard climbing calls correctly
Demonstrate basic footwork and balance on the wall

title: NICAS Level 2
subtitle: Indoor Lead Foundation
description: Develop the skills to lead climb safely indoors.

skills.label: Hold NICAS Level 1 award
Clip quickdraws correctly at low height
Clip quickdraws at full extension safely
Take controlled lead falls
Lead belay a climber safely
Catch a lead fall correctly
Read a route before climbing
Lead a route independently at your level

title: NICAS Level 3
subtitle: Indoor Lead Development
description: Develop consistent lead climbing technique and belaying skills under pressure.

skills.label: Hold NICAS Level 2 award
Lead routes consistently at your level
Use dynamic movement and coordination
Take falls confidently on overhung terrain
Belay confidently when a climber falls unexpectedly
Identify and manage risks at the wall
Lead 5 different routes at grade without falls
Plan and execute an appropriate warm-up routine

title: NICAS Level 4
subtitle: Outdoor Foundation
description: Transition skills for toproping and being seconded on outdoor rock.

skills.label: Hold NICAS Level 3 award
Identify common rock types and their properties
Understand outdoor access, ethics and conservation
Assess and use fixed anchors safely
Abseil safely from a fixed anchor
Identify environmental hazards on outdoor rock
Know emergency procedures and first aid principles
Second a roped route outdoors

title: NICAS Level 5
subtitle: Outdoor Lead
description: Lead climbing on outdoor rock with appropriate gear and judgement.

skills.label: Hold NICAS Level 4 award
Select an appropriate rack for the route
Place and assess protection reliably
Navigate a route using a guidebook and terrain features
Lead a pitch and bring up a second
Perform a basic self-rescue from a stuck belay
Manage fear and commitment on challenging terrain
Lead 5 outdoor routes with clean placements

title: NIBAS Level 1
subtitle: Bouldering Introduction
description: Safe and confident introduction to indoor bouldering.

skills.label: Understand bouldering wall etiquette and rules
Land safely from a controlled fall
Spot a fellow climber correctly
Use basic movement techniques on easy problems
Complete a suitable warm-up and cool-down

title: NIBAS Level 2
subtitle: Bouldering Development
description: Develop movement skills and problem-solving on moderate boulders.

skills.label: Hold NIBAS Level 1 award
Execute dynamic moves with control
Maintain body tension on steep terrain
Place feet precisely on small holds
Work out a V3/4 problem systematically
Understand basic training and injury prevention

title: NIBAS Level 3
subtitle: Advanced Bouldering
description: Advanced technique, power training, and introduction to coaching.

skills.label: Hold NIBAS Level 2 award
Demonstrate advanced techniques (heel hooks, toe hooks, drop knees)
Train power safely with appropriate rest periods
Prepare and compete in a bouldering competition
Provide basic movement feedback to a partner
Manage common finger and shoulder injuries proactively

title: NIBAS Level 4
subtitle: Bouldering Leader
description: Lead bouldering sessions, manage safety, and inspire others.

skills.label: Hold NIBAS Level 3 award
Plan and lead a bouldering session for a group
Conduct a risk assessment for a bouldering session
Teach movement technique to beginners effectively
Understand safeguarding responsibilities
Engage in continuing professional development
